name: Night Web's Hollow
summary: In Tirisfal Glades, spiders have overrun Night Web's Hollow, an abandoned gold mine northwest of Deathknell. Newly raised Forsaken are sent into its tunnels to cull the vermin and prove their readiness for combat.

sections.title: The Infested Mine
sections.body: Night Web's Hollow lies in the hills northwest of Deathknell. Before the plague swept through Lordaeron, humans worked its gold mine. After the kingdom fell, the shafts stood empty. Now webs cover the rock walls, and aggressive night web spiders fill the vale and tunnels. The Forsaken send their newly raised into the hollow to kill young and adult spiders and regain access to the mine's gold.

faq.answer: Night Web's Hollow is a small ravine and abandoned gold mine northwest of Deathknell. Webs cover the vale, and aggressive spiders swarm through it, making it an early proving ground for new Forsaken recruits.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken clearing out the spiders?
faq.answer: The Forsaken need the mine's gold, but spiders block the tunnels. Executor Arren has few hands to spare, so new recruits help clear the infestation over time.

faq.q: What lives deep inside the mine shafts?
faq.answer: Young spiders skitter through the vale, while full-grown Night Web Spiders prowl the tunnels. Deep in the darkest chamber lives the Night Web Matriarch, broodmother of the infestation.

faq.q: Was this always a spider den?
faq.answer: No. Before Lordaeron fell, local humans worked the mine for gold. After the Scourge wiped out the region, the shafts fell into disrepair, and spiders took shelter in the dark tunnels.

angles.text: For you, newly risen, Night Web's Hollow is one of your first trials. Slaying the arachnids proves you have the focus and will to serve the Dark Lady.
The shafts were dug for gold, but lethal spiders have halted mining there.
